🤖 AI

Create tasks much faster with AI.

Breaking down parent tasks, creating tasks from meeting records, 5 Whys analysis, and writing details. The extension creates the instructions (prompt) for the AI; paste the AI's answer and it goes straight into the bulk registration/update sheet or the new-task form.

What it does

Let AI handle the work of creating tasks

🤖

Break down a parent task with AI

From the parent task name, period, and work description, create child and grandchild tasks. The schedule starts the day after a prerequisite's due date, with completion conditions. Choose from three modes: simple, standard, and detailed.

🗒

AI: Create tasks from meeting records

From a Teams transcript or similar, extract only the action items with an owner and a deadline. They can be added to the bulk registration/update sheet.

🧭

AI 5 Whys Analysis

Write the incident name and details, and the AI digs into each cause with five levels of “why”, then finds root causes (aim for three or more) and one action task per root cause. Answer the AI's questions as you go (up to 5 times). From the result you can also download PowerPoint slides (2 slides)

✨

Write new-task details with AI

From a title and a short memo, create a readable detail with completion conditions. Paste the answer into the detail field and register as is.

How to use

Three steps from AI answer to tasks

①

Copy the prompt

Enter the parent task, the meeting date, and so on, and the instructions for the AI are created automatically and copied to the clipboard.

②

Paste it into the AI and send

The chosen AI opens in a new tab. You paste and send it yourself.

③

Paste the answer to import it

Just paste the AI's answer, and it goes into the sheet rows or the detail field. An answer with the wrong column layout is not imported, and the reason is shown.

Choose the AI you use

The AI you pick in the header dropdown is remembered for next time.

🏢

Microsoft 365 Copilot

The default AI. Use it with your work Microsoft 365 account.

🆓

Microsoft Copilot (free)

Free to use with a Microsoft account.

🟣

Claude

Use it in Anthropic's chat.

🟢

ChatGPT

Use it in OpenAI's chat.

🔒 The extension never sends data to AI. The prompt is copied to the clipboard, and you paste and send it yourself in the AI's screen. No API key is needed.

Try breaking down one parent task first

Breaking down a parent task is the easiest way to feel the effect.
